name: Shadowgrange
description: The village where Strefan sees Brandt ride past after years.

timeline.summary: In a flashback Strefan recalls his first encounter with Brandt decades earlier, when Brandt tore his glamer by shouting that a vampire was in the village.
timeline.quote: the young man began hollering that there was a vampire in their midst
